review: The hymn is the approach to the throne: 1:1–4 is Heb 4:16 with Ps 27:4, the chorus is Ps 73:25–26 with Phil 4:7, 2:1–4 is Ps 119:32 with Ps 43:3, and 3:1–4 is Phil 3:12–14 with 1 John 1:5.

The chorus follows stanza 1 as the print's [القرار]; the payload keeps it as the labelled second stanza, with the threefold 'in You / from You' of the Arabic مِنْكَ / فِيكَ preserved in the middle couplet.

3:3 לֹא יַסְנוּר נָגְהָהּ — the Arabic لَنْ يَبْهَرَ بَرِيقُهَا is 'its glitter shall not dazzle'; the Hebrew uses סָנוּר in the sense of blinding glare with נֹגַהּ (Isa 60:3), because the line must name the dazzle that the eye which has seen God's light no longer fears.
